speaker: Doctor
text: I need to assess your current vital signs and mental status immediately; please tell me if you are experiencing fever, sweating, rapid heart rate, or dilated pupils right now. Additionally, have you been taking any new medications, supplements, or illicit drugs recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text: I note your age and the reported stress, but your symptoms of aggression, altered mental status, and autonomic instability are concerning for a toxic or metabolic emergency. Did anyone notice if you have been using cocaine, methamphetamines, or other stimulants, especially in the last 24 hours? REQUEST TEST: Urine_Drug_Screen; REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the absence of fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, and urinary issues, along with your diaphoresis and aggressive behavior, I am ruling out common infections or metabolic acidosis.
